purpose: Reading layer: replace only engine mispronunciations; on-screen text stays canonical.
how_it_is_used: Validate each rule against the whole film before synthesis; fail before the network call if the count differs.
Write the substituted text to .tmp/narration/film/film_reading.txt; keep the canonical text for comparison.
Map sentence-frame text back to canonical before writing subtitles.
alignment_note: Substitutions can change character count, so align by sentence frame, not by character position.

example_rule.issue: The engine spells out all-caps acronyms.
example_rule.why_this_reading: Lowercase ram is read as a word; the leading D stays a letter.
